subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should package changelog previews permanently allow direct package owners, authorized publisher-org members, moderators, and administrators to read prior release content before generating a preview?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately choosing who may access historical package material; this is a product and trust-boundary policy that tests can verify mechanically but cannot select safely.

options.title: Approve and specify the proposed policy
options.body: Keep the current role set and add a focused durable specification for the before-storage-read authorization invariant.

options.title: Narrow the preview audience
options.body: Restrict the allowed roles before merge if moderation or organization membership should not imply access to prior package-release content.

recommendation.title: Approve and specify the proposed policy
recommendation.body: Keep the current role set and add a focused durable specification for the before-storage-read authorization invariant.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently merged substantial work on the plugin publish flow that this change extends.
